title: Easter Family, Father Children Rabbit and Dog - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming post-war outdoor snapshot capturing an American family celebrating Easter beside the side of their house. A father in mid-century slacks and a collared shirt stands holding a paper bag, flanked by his three children: a boy holding a white rabbit, a young girl in a patterned collar, and a grinning toddler holding a woven Easter basket. In the foreground, a dark-furred family dog sits facing them under the dappled shade of a leafy tree.
